system.description: With the spirit of the wolf, the spirit conjurer unleashes the hunter within and can stalk the dark depths of the wild as a predator rather than prey. The dimwalker calls upon the spirit and their hands grow powerful claws. The spirit conjurer can use these claws in unarmed combat, dealing 1d10 (OR 10) points of damage.
